about_the_game:
Welcome to Groovity!

Groovity is a vibrant 2.5D platformer where you can change gravity at will.

Manipulate gravity as you explore a spaceship full of traps, puzzles and dangers. Walk on the ceiling, fall down walls and dodge projectiles as you move at full speed. Groovity proposes you to think in motion and break the traditional logic of platformers.

What does this Demo contain?

This demo includes the complete levels 1 and 2, as well as a final boss fight.

Level 1 - NeoCosmos Test Laboratory

Your adventure in Groovity begins by retrieving the gravity shifting prototype that NeoCosmos kept under lock and key.

Deep inside the test lab, Groovy, our protagonist, equips himself with his new prototype to begin his escape. As he learns his new abilities, he progresses through increasingly complex levels. Each room presents new challenges and deadly traps that will test your reflexes and understanding of the gravitational system.

In this first level, you will learn the basics of surviving in a ship designed so that no one can escape.

But the problems don't end here. At the end of the laboratory, Johnny, the boss of NeoCosmos, discovers Groovy's plans and unleashes a relentless chase. In this intense chase, you will have to apply everything you have learned: move quickly, think vertically and adapt to the environment in real time.

It's the first big test. And not everyone manages to escape from Johnny's clutches...

Level 2 - Funky Lab

After narrowly escaping from Johnny, Groovy continues his journey through the ship in search of freedom.

In this new section, he will face new enemies and areas that alter his anti-gravity equipment, either limiting his abilities or temporarily amplifying them. These new encounters challenge your control of the character, but open up alternate routes that allow for new movement strategies. Each room is an experiment, and Groovy is the test subject.

After negotiating the NeoCosmos labs, Groovy once again crosses paths with Johnny. Angry about your previous encounter, this time he is not willing to let you escape. In this epic combat, you'll have to master everything you've learned: every jump, every gravity change and every boost counts.

Get ready for the ultimate challenge!
